war_complete_sequence_observations: Actual uncaptioned W01-F1 through W06-F1 carries a clear large-scale arc: establish enormous threat, pressure breaks formation, shield pulse reaches raised foreleg, sword sustains an occupied ice route, main bridge falls, exhausted defenders oversee continuing retreat.

Strongest gains are repeated city/gate geography, tiny-to-medium-to-vertical camera variation, source-target pressure direction, readable distinct adult silhouettes and massive falling slab consequences. Broad finished surfaces retain depth and military scale.

Foreleg joint contact improved after repair, but shoulder lowering/four-leg weight distribution remains incompletely visible. Ice far-bank landing was never fully shown. W05 omits the occupied/maintained route; W06 restores it with adults still crossing.

W06 does not prove all survivors safe, blade lifted, growth stopped or gate closing. Foreground heroes replace the specified tiny extreme-wide finish. Main-road loss buys time; an intact guarded ice route cannot prove total pursuit prevention.

The complete six-image war story communicates meaningful sacrifice and team dependency, with ongoing rather than completed evacuation. It is an appealing bounded sequence with state/geography limitations, not full choreography acceptance.
